title: Run the FR-40 experiment and record its verdict
body:
FR-40 slice 4 of 4 (parent t-y46gy0w). Run the experiment and record the verdict.
What: run the frozen manifest with `krn eval session` (Codex gpt-6-luna, mask on, AGENTS.md on in every arm) in the planned shuffled order; stop after 20 tasks if B is not ahead; record every run's session.json and score; arms that cannot run are reported invalid with reasons.
Acceptance: results table and GO/KILL/inconclusive verdicts against D20 thresholds committed under evals/fr40/; t-y46gy0w closed with the verdict; ADR 0002 status updated only if GO.
